title: The Social Bases of AKP Local Power
content:
This study, co-authored with Süleyman Kıroğlu and published in *European Politics and Society*, examines the social foundations of the Justice and Development Party's (AKP) organizational strength at the local level in Istanbul.

#### **Overview:**

Moving from national narratives to the people who actually run the party on the ground, the research analyzes the social backgrounds of AKP district-organization leaders. It identifies three recurring profiles — *rural notables*, *professionals*, and *ideologues* — and shows how each ties the party to distinct constituencies, networks, and resources.

#### **Key Findings and Contributions:**

By connecting classic center–periphery dynamics to the everyday work of local party organization, the paper offers a bottom-up account of how the AKP assembles and sustains durable grassroots power through its local cadres.

#### **Publication:**

Kıroğlu, S., & Koytak, H. Z. (2026). Rural notables, professionals, and ideologues: the social bases of AKP local power. *European Politics and Society*. [https://doi.org/10.1080/23745118.2026.2620579](https://doi.org/10.1080/23745118.2026.2620579)
